description: dump_c writes the C before Defk.Build.build! (lib/defk.ex:475) but still runs cc on every kernel. Add a C-only mode that skips cc (the module must still load or be skipped cleanly; on_load needs care). Add a selection (--only test files / examples). Write docs/agents/runs.md, linked from AGENTS.md: refactor that must keep C -> C-only dump_c; change in one compiler area -> unit tests + the affected examples' check only; no bench run unless asked; known-poor rows never re-measured unless asked. Update the compiler-time method (interleaved dump_c rounds) to use the C-only mode.
